overview.description: The Innovator International Developed Power Buffer ETF December (IDEC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the MSCI EAFE Index over a specific holdings period. The actively-managed fund holds options and collateral. IDEC was launched on Nov 30, 2023 and is issued by Innovator.
